name: Intent UI
summary: MIT accessible React Aria + Tailwind copy-paste UI via shadcn registry (@intentui).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of a much larger Intent UI catalog.
Requires shadcn init with an Intent UI theme (e.g. `npx shadcn@latest init @intentui/theme-default`).
Built on React Aria Components; peer dependency required.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Accessible button with intents, sizes, pending state.

demo.peerNotes: Use Intent UI free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://intentui.com/docs/components/buttons/button

copyPrompt.text: Use Intent UI free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://intentui.com/docs/components/buttons/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @intentui/button` (registry https://intentui.com/r/button). Home/docs: https://intentui.com. Repo: https://github.com/intentui/intentui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intentui/intentui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2024 Irsyad A. Panjaitan). Pricing free.
